title: Fluctuations of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick free energy at critical temperature
summary: We consider the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick spin glass model at the critical inverse temperature $β= 1$ with zero external field. We prove that the free energy $F_N = F_{N,β=1}$ of this model has variance \[ \mathrm{Var}(F_N) = \frac16 \log N + O(1)\,, \] confirming a physics prediction of Aspelmeier \cite{aspelmeier2008free}, and that the centered and scaled $F_N$ satisfies a Gaussian CLT.
